runtime_contract.hardware_policy: Record exact CUDA GPU. H100/H200 is the upstream-matched condition; other BF16-capable CUDA GPUs remain explicit distinct runtime conditions.

execution.repeatability_basis: Phase 2A retained Evidence: 18/18 conditions byte-identical across three repeats.

trace_stages: encoded input and absolute semantic spans
aligned option mean-span backbone context vectors
aligned lexical option vectors from output embeddings

head_only_counterfactual.only_intervention: reorder EncodedRecord.questions tuple to the target question order
head_only_counterfactual.alignment: compare outputs by question_id, not tuple position

invariants: Phase 2B inherits exactly the 3 fixtures and 6 packed question-order conditions frozen by Phase 1C and reused by Phase 2A.
Phase 2B takes one actual observation per condition because Phase 2A already froze and observed exact 3-repeat local repeatability for all 18 conditions.
The released model weights, joint head, tokenizer/processor, dtype, max length, and runtime family are unchanged from Phase 2A.
The fixed-backbone counterfactual never mutates weights, hidden values, canonical input_ids, or semantic spans; it changes only the order of EncodedQuestion objects supplied to the released head.
No semantic, numerical-noise, or causality threshold is selected before output.
No Phase 2A Evidence file is modified.
A non-H100/H200 run remains a distinct runtime condition.
